title: A filter on another column of the table gives one visible value but no direct filter
query: ROW ( "Has One Filter", HASONEFILTER ( Product[Category] ), "Has One Value", HASONEVALUE ( Product[Category] ) ),

source.quote: HASONEFILTER is not HASONEVALUE. -- A column can have only one value visible because of -- cross-filtering.
source.supports: the page shows this pair of measures returning false and true for a filter on the product name

derivation: The filter is on Product[Product]. Only Lock is visible, so Product[Category] shows one value, Accessories: HASONEVALUE is TRUE. Product[Category] has no direct filter, so FILTERS returns both categories and HASONEFILTER is FALSE.
